points.description: States one valid limitation of wireframe modeling: the representation is ambiguous (one wireframe can be read as different solids), or it is messy/confusing/cluttered (e.g., hidden lines, no surface or volume information).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if the answer is vague or only loosely related to ambiguity/confusion (e.g., 'not realistic' or 'hard to understand') without a clear limitation.

rubric.notes: Full marks for any one clear limitation matching the model answer's idea: ambiguity (one model, several possible solids) or messy/confusing appearance, in any wording. Give 1 mark for a vague or partly relevant drawback. Give 0 for wrong or unrelated answers; extra remarks do not cost marks.
